articles.title: Patrick Mahomes faces a potential Chiefs setback after Rashee Rice’s latest practice development
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes could be short of another key target when the Kansas City Chiefs return to action against the Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday.
articles.body: Patrick Mahomes could be short of another key target when the Kansas City Chiefs return to action against the Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday. Rashee Rice missed Wednesday’s practice with a hamstring injury, raising fresh questions about his availability for Week 6. The Chiefs are unbeaten at 4-0 and have had a bye to prepare, but Rice’s absence would complicate their plans. With Tyquan Thornton also out after suffering a serious ankle injury, Kansas City may have to rely more heavily on its younger receivers. That puts added pressure on Mahomes to adjust quickly if Rice cannot play.Rashee Rice’s practice absence creates another problem for Patrick MahomesRice has become an important part of Kansas City’s passing game, recording 13 catches for 190 yards and one touchdown in four games this season. His ability to find space and give Mahomes a dependable option makes his health a major concern, particularly with the Chiefs already missing Thornton.Rice injured his hamstring during the Week 4 game against the Las Vegas Raiders. Although the bye week gave him extra time to recover, he was still unable to practice on Wednesday. The Chiefs have not ruled him out for Sunday, but hamstring injuries can be difficult to predict. A player may feel better before he is ready to handle the demands of a full game.Head coach Andy Reid offered a cautious update on Rice’s condition.“We'll see how it goes,” Reid said of Rice's prospects for practicing later this week. “He's actually feeling pretty good as he goes here, so we'll see. Those things, you start dealing with hamstrings, and it could be a week, could be two weeks, you don't know, but I know he's eager to get back in.”Reid’s comments leave the door open for a return, but they also show why Kansas City cannot count on Rice just yet. The Chiefs will need to monitor his progress before deciding how much they can rely on him against the Chargers.Chiefs’ young receivers face a bigger test if Rice sits outRice’s potential absence also makes Thornton’s injury more significant. Kansas City has lost two receivers who could help stretch the field and create space for the rest of the offense. Xavier Worthy remains an option for Mahomes, but the Chiefs may also need Jalen Royals and Cyrus Allen to contribute more than they have so far.Mahomes has backed the younger players, pointing to their preparation and the trust they have built with him in practice.“They’ve put in the work,” Mahomes explained. “Obviously, we’ve had the guys in front of them with Tyquan going out there and playing great football, and so they’ve had to put in the work at practice, and they’ve been doing that. So now their number gets called, and they’re going to step into the role and do their job. I’m excited for them. We’ll put them in position to succeed. I have a lot of trust in those guys, a lot of confidence in them, and so we’ll continue to push it forward.”That trust will matter if the Chiefs have to change their plans on Sunday. Mahomes can help young receivers by keeping their assignments clear, but they must still read coverage, find openings and make plays when the ball comes their way.Kansas City has started well, yet Rice’s status is an important test of its depth. The Chiefs do not need to panic, but they do need other receivers ready to deliver if one of Mahomes’ most reliable options cannot suit up.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Will Sam Darnold play against the Denver Broncos tonight? Latest injury update on the Seattle Seahawks popular star
articles.summary: The Seattle Seahawks have recorded an average run on the field in the new season as the team has won in 3 matches but lost in 2 so far.
articles.body: The Seattle Seahawks have recorded an average run on the field in the new season as the team has won in 3 matches but lost in 2 so far. In Weeks 1 and 2, the Seattle Seahawks ended up losing against the New England Patriots and the Arizona Cardinals but ended up losing in Week 3 against the Washington Commanders. In Week 4, the Seattle Seahawks won against the Los Angeles Chargers but ended up losing against the San Francisco 49ers in Week 5. Ahead of the Week 6 clash against the Denver Broncos, all eyes remain on Sam Darnold.Is Sam Darnold fit enough to take the field for the Seattle Seahawks as the team prepares to go against the Denver Broncos?Yes, the Seattle Seahawks’ popular quarterback Sam Darnold is completely healthy and starting for the team in their Week 6 Thursday Night Football matchup against the Denver Broncos.The Seattle Seahawks have officially ruled out three players for their Week 6 game against the Denver Broncos including running back Zach Charbonnet (knee), linebacker Drake Thomas (ankle), and linebacker Chazz Surratt (calf).On the positive side, star wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba (ankle) and defensive tackle Leonard Williams (ankle) both logged full practice participation by Wednesday and carry no injury designations, clearing them to play without restrictions. Backup quarterback Drew Lock (forearm) and guard Beau Stephens (shoulder) are also fully cleared and ready to go.Sam Darnold’s injury history and performance in the new seasonWhile Sam Darnold is completely fit now, he had sustained a minor injury in the Week 1 clash against the New England Patriots.For the unversed, the injury occurred just five snaps into the Seattle Seahawks' season opening game against the New England Patriots. While it was initially reported as a hip injury, medical scans later clarified that his hip joint was completely unaffected.Despite early medical estimates suggesting he could miss four to six weeks, the popular quarterback Sam Darnold made a speedy recovery.He missed only one game in Week 2 against the Arizona Cardinals before being fully cleared to return to action ahead of schedule for Week 3 against the Washington Commanders.Through four games played in the 2026 NFL regular season, Sam Darnold has recorded a 90.3 passer rating, throwing for 755 yards, 7 touchdowns, and 5 interceptions.During the 2025 NFL season, Sam Darnold had a career year, leading the Seattle Seahawks to a franchise-record 14 regular-season wins, the NFC's No. 1 seed, and a victory in Super Bowl LX.The popular quarterback also earned his second consecutive Pro Bowl selection by starting all 17 regular-season games and crossing the 4,000-yard passing threshold for the second year in a row.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Jason Kelce and Kylie Kelce reach major $3.69 million fundraising milestone as Team 62 delivers record-breaking autism support
articles.summary: Earlier this year, Jason Kelce and Kylie Kelce turned a summer gathering into a powerful show of support for the autism community.
articles.body: Earlier this year, Jason Kelce and Kylie Kelce turned a summer gathering into a powerful show of support for the autism community. Their annual Team 62 fundraiser brought together Philadelphia Eagles fans, players, families and local supporters for a cause that continues to make a difference. The sixth edition raised more than $1.26 million in a single evening, pushing the event’s total fundraising past $3.69 million since 2021. Beyond the impressive figures, the achievement reflects how the couple have built a lasting connection with families affected by autism and helped strengthen the Eagles’ community outreach.Jason and Kylie Kelce push Team 62 fundraising past $3.69 millionThe latest Team 62 fundraiser took place on June 24 at Ocean Drive in Sea Isle City, New Jersey. What began as a charitable initiative has grown into a major annual event supporting the Eagles Autism Foundation, which funds autism research and community programmes.The record-breaking result also highlights the influence Jason and Kylie have built beyond football. Jason, a former Philadelphia Eagles centre and Super Bowl champion, remains a popular figure among fans. Alongside Kylie, he has helped make Team 62 a recurring opportunity for the community to support a cause that reaches far beyond the sport.The couple marked the milestone with gratitude for the people who have helped the fundraiser grow over six years.“Six years later, we now stand here amazed at what we’ve accomplished for the autism community,” read a statement.“A special thank you also goes out to the Eagles organization, the incredible town of Sea Isle City, and most importantly, the best fans in the world for always showing up and supporting such a worthy cause.”The continued growth of Team 62 shows how sustained community involvement can turn a local event into a significant fundraising effort.Team 62 brings the Eagles community together for autism supportThe fundraiser offered more than an evening of celebrity appearances. Organisers planned activities throughout the weekend to help people of different abilities participate and feel included.The Eagles Autism Foundation hosted an all-abilities football clinic, a cheerleading clinic, an Eagles drumline workshop, beach yoga and interactive activities for families. These sessions gave attendees opportunities to connect with the team and take part in the festivities.The main event at Ocean Drive featured celebrity bartenders from the current and former Eagles roster, members of the Kelce family, including Donna Kelce, team cheerleaders and mascot SWOOP. Guests could support the cause through tips, raffles, merchandise purchases and direct donations.Other fundraising efforts included the fourth annual Beer Bowl at the Sea Isle City Yacht Club, an online auction and entry fees from community activities.Eagles Autism Foundation executive director Ryan Hammond also praised Jason and Kylie for their commitment, recognising their role in making Team 62 one of the organisation’s key annual events.The $3.69 million milestone represents years of effort from the Kelces, the Eagles organisation and their supporters. With each edition bringing more people into the fold, Team 62 continues to show how sports, local partnerships and inclusive activities can help raise funds and awareness for the autism community.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Who are Sam Darnold’s parents? Meet the plumber dad and PE teacher mom behind the Seahawks star’s rise
articles.summary: Sam Darnold’s path to the NFL has a family story that reaches beyond football.
articles.body: Sam Darnold’s path to the NFL has a family story that reaches beyond football. The Seattle Seahawks quarterback grew up with a father who worked as a plumber and a mother who taught physical education. Both parents brought their own connection to sports into his childhood, giving him a home where athletics were familiar but not the family’s only focus. His grandfather also had a notable sporting background, adding another layer to the family’s history. For fans curious about the person behind the quarterback, Mike and Chris Darnold offer a closer look at the people who shaped his early years.Who are Sam Darnold’s parents, Mike and Chris Darnold?Sam’s father, Mike Darnold, worked as a medical gas plumber, while his mother, Chris Darnold, built her career as a physical education teacher. Their professions were far removed from the demands and attention of professional football, but both had a clear connection to physical activity and sport.Chris’s work in physical education placed movement and fitness at the center of her professional life. Mike, meanwhile, worked outside the sports world. His job offered a different example for his son: a career built around practical skills and everyday responsibilities.That contrast makes the family’s story more interesting than a standard account of an NFL player’s upbringing. Sam grew up in a household where sport was part of the picture, but so was ordinary working life. His parents had careers of their own, and his development as an athlete took place alongside those commitments.The family did not need an NFL background to understand the value of sports. Their own experiences gave Sam a foundation before he began pursuing football at a higher level.How Sam Darnold’s family shaped his sporting backgroundAthletic ability runs through more than one branch of the Darnold family. Sam’s grandfather, Dick Hammer, was a former athlete who played basketball at the University of Southern California and competed in volleyball at the 1964 Summer Olympics. He later became known to television audiences for his role as the Marlboro Man.Hammer’s background gives Sam’s family history an unusual connection to both competitive sport and popular culture. His Olympic experience stands out, but the Marlboro Man association is another detail that may surprise football fans who know Sam mainly for his work as a quarterback.The family’s sporting history does not, by itself, explain Sam’s NFL career. Reaching the professional level takes years of training, performance and opportunity. Still, the presence of athletics across generations helps explain why sport was a familiar part of his family background.For Sam, that history offered a connection to competitive sport that stretched beyond his own football career. It also meant that his journey was not the first time someone in the family had pursued athletics at a high level.From a family home to the NFL spotlightSam’s rise has taken him into a world very different from the daily working lives of his parents. NFL quarterbacks face constant scrutiny, from their performances on Sundays to questions about their leadership and long-term prospects. Their families, however, often remain outside that public conversation.Mike and Chris Darnold’s backgrounds offer a more grounded view of Sam’s early life. One worked in plumbing, the other in education, and their family history included an Olympic athlete. Those details help explain the environment in which the quarterback grew up without reducing his success to his family connections.Sam’s career belongs to him, built through his own decisions and work on the field. But his story also has roots in a family whose experiences extended well beyond professional football. For supporters looking to understand the person behind the Seahawks quarterback, that is an important part of the picture.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes’ Kansas City Current take first step toward a $1.4 billion riverfront expansion
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes, the Kansas City Chiefs’ star player, and his wife, popular entrepreneur and investor Brittany Mahomes, have remained committed to their
articles.body: Patrick Mahomes, the Kansas City Chiefs’ star player, and his wife, popular entrepreneur and investor Brittany Mahomes, have remained committed to their investment in the NWSL team, the Kansas City Current. As the Kansas City Current works on expanding the CPKC Stadium and building an entertainment district around it, there has been an update.Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes’ Kansas City Current makes the first move towards expansion around CPKC StadiumA few days ago, as per reports, there has been a launch of the first sports bar that has opened at Kansas City’s riverfront development, Current Landing. Revel, created by Shawn Lawson and Danney Elmore.The cafe is at the outdoor plaza just opposite to the entry to CPKC Stadium, home of the KC Current.In a press release, Josh Goldman, managing director at Palmer Square Real Estate, said, “The addition of Revel at Current Landing strengthens the district’s identity as a destination…It’s a social anchor—bringing together sophisticated hospitality, the energy of sport, and the rhythm of the riverfront into one cohesive experience.”Danney Elmore, the co-founder of the cafe, added, “We’re just happy to be down there at the Current Landing in the new entertainment district, and can’t wait to see what comes from it. And we’d love to have everybody out for a drink and some food,” he said.He continued, “Being the first open is allowing us to learn how this entertainment district will run... (and) we’re able to share all the troubles and mistakes that are happening, so they can avoid it. So it kind of gives us a level of camaraderie with the people coming in to where I don’t think we would get right off the bat.”What is the Kansas City Current busy building around their home ground, the CPKC Stadium as a $1.4 billion budget is approved?For the unversed, the Kansas City Current's vision for Current Landing and the Berkley Riverfront has officially moved from concept to reality, backed by a massive $1.4 billion multi phase master development plan.Following a major development agreement finalized in September 2026, the Kansas City Current women's soccer team has plans to build a brand new neighborhood around their stadium on the riverfront.Backed by the team's ownership group, including Angie and Chris Long alongside Patrick and Brittany Mahomes, this project increases stadium capacity by 6,500 seats to position Kansas City to host major international events like the 2031 FIFA Women's World Cup.Beyond sports, the newly opened first phase of the Current Landing district creates a walkable village featuring 429 waterfront apartments, 1,500 new parking spaces, and 48,000 square feet of retail space designed for 18 local shops and restaurants.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: “Will help make that vision a reality”: How Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes’ foundation donates $15,000 to help children with autism as  their food allergy mission continues
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes' 15 and the Mahomies Foundation has donated $15,000 to the Thompson Foundation for Autism & Neurodevelopment to help build an accessible
articles.body: Patrick Mahomes' 15 and the Mahomies Foundation has donated $15,000 to the Thompson Foundation for Autism & Neurodevelopment to help build an accessible playground for children of all abilities. The grant will support the new Thompson Center at the University of Missouri, giving children a space to play and develop essential life skills.The donation is one part of the foundation's work with children and families. Patrick and Brittany Mahomes have also supported food allergy awareness through their partnership with Food Allergy Research & Education (FARE), a cause that became personal after their own children experienced allergic reactions. Patrick Mahomes' $15,000 grant will help create a playground for children of all abilitiesThe Thompson Foundation announced the grant on November 1, 2024. The playground is part of the new Thompson Center for Autism & Neurodevelopment and is designed to help children develop social, emotional, physical and mental skills through play.Dr. Connie Brooks, executive director of the Thompson Center, attended the 15 and the Mahomies Foundation Gala on October 28 with Jeremiah Oakley and his sister, Jakayla Henson. Brooks and Jeremiah accepted the donation from Mahomes at the event.Brooks explained how the playground could help children beyond their time outdoors.“The new playground will offer so much more than a place to play; it’s an environment where kids can practice important life skills in a setting designed specifically for them,” she said.She also thanked the foundation for supporting the project.“This grant from the 15 and the Mahomies Foundation will help make that vision a reality, and we’re excited to bring it to our community,” Brooks added.The new Thompson Center facility was designed to expand services for people with autism and other neurodevelopmental conditions. It will double the number of patient rooms, allowing the centre to care for more families. Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes continue supporting families dealing with food allergiesThe couple has also used their public platform to help families understand food allergies. Through their foundation's partnership with FARE, they have supported educational efforts aimed at helping parents prepare for allergic reactions and manage food allergies at home and school.Their involvement comes from personal experience. Brittany has spoken about the frightening reaction their son Bronze experienced as a baby after trying peanut powder. She noticed hives spreading across his body and face within minutes.Brittany already had an AUVI-Q epinephrine auto-injector because their daughter Sterling had previously experienced food allergies. She used the injector during Bronze's reaction, but the family still took him to the emergency room, where doctors monitored him for several hours.The family has since spoken publicly about the need for awareness and preparation. Their support for FARE has included fundraising and educational events for families navigating similar challenges.The Thompson Center grant focuses on a different need, but it reflects the foundation's wider work to support children and their families. In this case, the $15,000 contribution will help create a place where children of all abilities can play, learn and build social skills.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: NFL insider reveals when Tyreek Hill could return to the Chiefs as Kansas City reportedly reaches out to his agent
articles.summary: Tyreek Hill, the former Miami Dolphins’ wide receiver, has been a topic of discussion for the last few weeks while his personal life and broken marriage
articles.body: Tyreek Hill, the former Miami Dolphins’ wide receiver, has been a topic of discussion for the last few weeks while his personal life and broken marriage with Keeta Vaccaro has dominated headlines. While now he has been ordered to pay $500,000 to his estranged wife, an NFL insider is hinted that when things between Tyreek Hill and his former team, the Kansas City Chiefs, can finally progress.NFL insider weighs in on when Tyreek Hill could be eyeing a return in the Kansas City ChiefsA few days ago, according to The Athletic's NFL insider Michael Silver’s recent report, it seems the star wide receiver Tyreek Hill "is believed to be targeting a November return"The Athletic's NFL insider Michael Silver added, "In the wake of those injuries, the Chiefs have already reached out to Hill's agent, Drew Rosenhaus, to express their interest…”The Athletic's NFL insider Michael Silver continued, "They'd have to be satisfied with the receiver's recovery, but there would likely be no other obstacles on the organization's end. His tenure in Kansas City ended on reasonably good terms, and people inside the organization believe he would fit in well with the current team."However, neither the 8 time Pro Bowler Tyreek Hill nor his former team, the Kansas City Chiefs, have confirmed the speculations yet.While the former Miami Dolphins’ wide receiver Tyreek Hill has been dealing with the mess in his personal life, there have also been serious concerns about his recovery.What really happened to Tyreek Hill in the last season after a strong performance on the field in the last few years?For the unversed, the 32 year old free agent wide receiver Tyreek Hill suffered a severe, season ending injury to his left knee during Week 4 of the 2025 NFL season against the New York Jets, which included a dislocated knee and multiple torn ligaments such as his ACL.After undergoing surgeries and being released by the Miami Dolphins, the star player has been continuing his rehabilitation with a target return window around November 2026.Tyreek Hill’s agent Drew Rosenhaus also weighed in on his situation as he said, "I think a deal could happen any time…We are looking for the right situation, the right contract, the right team, the right fit, the right approach.”Tyreek Hill’s agent Drew Rosenhaus added, "From a medical standpoint, Tyreek's feeling really good healthwise. I did say last week I thought a deal could happen at any time…”Tyreek Hill’s agent Drew Rosenhaus continued, "But in the NFL, it really is day to day. So we are still working to find the right situation."The star wide receiver has kept himself distant from all the discussions.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: “There is nothing in our life that can be accomplished as..": How Tom Brady’s $120,000 golf auction supported a cause he has backed for more than 20 years
articles.summary: Tom Brady has spent years supporting Best Buddies International, a nonprofit that works with people with intellectual and developmental disabilities.
articles.body: Tom Brady has spent years supporting Best Buddies International, a nonprofit that works with people with intellectual and developmental disabilities. On Nov.17, 2023, the former New England Patriots and Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback helped the organisation raise money through a golf experience that fetched $120,000 at its Miami gala.The auction offered more than a chance to play golf with an NFL legend. It supported a cause Brady had backed for over two decades, with the event raising $5 million in total for Best Buddies programs.How Tom Brady’s golf experience raised $120,000 for Best BuddiesAt the 25th Annual Best Buddies Miami Gala, Brady co-hosted a live auction with Anthony K. Shriver, the organisation’s founder, chairman and CEO. Their auction featured a golf experience and lunch at Indian Creek Golf Course. The package raised $120,000 for the nonprofit.Best Buddies announced the results on Nov. 22, 2023, in its official event report. The gala took place five days earlier and also honoured Brady with the Spirit of Leadership Award for his contributions to the organisation.The evening included a dinner, live and silent auctions, and a performance by Grammy-winning artist Nelly. Brady also tossed autographed footballs into the crowd as part of the fundraising effort.The golf auction formed one part of a larger event. Best Buddies said the gala raised $5 million to support its work creating opportunities for friendship, employment, leadership development and inclusive living for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Why Best Buddies has remained close to Tom BradyBrady’s involvement with Best Buddies goes well beyond one fundraising night. The organisation said he had served as a global ambassador, advocate and supporter for more than 20 years by November 2023. His work helped the nonprofit raise over $100 million.During his acceptance speech at the November 17, 2023, Miami gala, Brady spoke about the value of relationships and support systems.“There is nothing in our life that can be accomplished as an individual,” Brady said at the event. “It always comes down to who’s in our life, who’s supporting us and who our friends are. That’s what the Best Buddies mission is all about.”Best Buddies works to build friendships and create opportunities for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Its programs also support employment, leadership and independent living.Brady’s support for Best Buddies also reflects his belief in the role that friendship and strong personal connections play in people’s lives. His remarks at the gala went beyond the auction itself, highlighting the value of having people who offer support and encouragement. That message aligns with the organisation’s work to help people with intellectual and developmental disabilities build meaningful relationships and find greater opportunities in their communities.The gala showed how Brady used his public profile to help raise funds for that mission. The $120,000 golf experience was one part of the effort while the event’s $5 million total supported Best Buddies programs on a wider scale.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates.
